subject: Re: Renewal decision — request for concession to retain Aurelia Labs
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara@aurelia-labs.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Jon Paxton <jon.paxton@aurelia-labs.com>, procurement@aurelia-labs.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal — pause on renewal unless terms improved

Connor,

After an internal review we’ve decided not to move forward on the renewal at the current terms. Key reasons: higher unit cost compared with alternatives, lack of a 99.9% SLA commitment for our busiest tier, and the team needs a short-term price stability guarantee while we finish an internal migration off a legacy model.

We value Redwood’s performance but to continue we need either a material discount or a credit + SLA for the first 6 months. If Redwood can’t accommodate, Procurement will move to a competitive RFP.

Can you escalate? I’m including procurement and Jon (ops) on this thread.

— Sara
Head of ML Infrastructure
Aurelia Labs
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lin <sara@aurelia-labs.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — pause on renewal unless terms improved

Sara — thanks for the candid note and for laying out the blocker. I’m sorry to hear you’re considering an RFP. I’ll escalate immediately to our deal desk and sales leadership and come back with a proposed concession.

A couple quick clarifying q's to make sure we propose something useful:
- Is procurement primarily seeking a % discount, or would a one-time invoice credit + SLA guarantee work?
- Are you able to share target budget or target unit price range?

I’ll get internal eyes on this today and follow up by end of week. Attach: Aurelia_Usage_Summary_Q3.xlsx (usage/cost breakdown you shared)

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Renewal — pause on renewal unless terms improved — urgent exec signoff needed

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding an at-risk renewal (Aurelia Labs, AL-2023-078). Customer has signaled intent to go to RFP unless we provide concession. Key facts: ~ $420k ARR, growing usage, Q3 spikes that would benefit from a short-term SLA guarantee, procurement asking for discount or credit to match alternatives.

Proposed save package to present for approval (draft):
- 30% one-year discount off list for core inference usage OR
- Option B: one-time invoice credit equal to 3 months of average spend (est. $105k) + 6-month SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.9% uptime for their production route, with automatic fallbacks to a lower-cost model after 6 months if performance targets not met.
- 12-month price lock (no increases) and free migration assistance (2 weeks of engineering hours).

Asks:
1) Exec signoff authority for Option B (credit + SLA) — we need authority to commit up to $120k net concession (credit + engineering hours) without legal escalation.
2) Quick legal to review SLA addendum (I can kick off the draft).

Customer timeline: procurement said they’ll wait 7–10 business days for our response before distributing the RFP.

I can brief you on a quick call if helpful.

Connor
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: Renewal — pause on renewal unless terms improved — urgent exec signoff needed

Connor — thanks for the summary. A few notes:
- Margin sensitivity: 30% is large; prefer Option B since it lets us tie concession to performance and duration.
- SLA language needs a clear credit calculation (e.g., per-hour credit buckets after the first hour of downtime) and rollback triggers. Legal will need to sign off but we can scope the addendum as a temporary overlay (6 months) to avoid long-term exposure.
- Confirmed: we have precedent to approve up to $125k net concession for strategic accounts with VP notice.

Rishi — flagging you for executive approval to commit Option B (credit + SLA + 2 weeks engineering). Connor: can you attach the usage summary and a 1-pager impact projection? I'll route to legal once we have the SLA terms.

Marissa
SVP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_coole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: Renewal — urgent exec signoff needed

Team — I’ve reviewed the account metrics and the proposed Option B. Given the strategic nature and the fact Aurelia is expanding usage, I approve the following one-time concession terms:
- Up to $115,000 invoice credit (to be applied pro rata across the first invoice) + SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.9% for 6 months with defined credit buckets.
- 10 days of engineering support (remote) to help their migration and optimize tokenization/caching.
- 12-month price lock.

Conditions:
- Legal to finalize SLA wording and credit mechanics (no absolute penalties beyond credit).
- Concession will be contingent on signed amendment and purchase order within 10 business days.

Marking this as Approved-by-VP. Connor — you have authority to close under these terms and send the formal amendment.

Rishi
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lin <sara@aurelia-labs.com>, Jon Paxton <jon.paxton@aurelia-labs.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-labs.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — request for concession to retain Aurelia Labs

Sara / Jon — thank you for your patience. I’m pleased to confirm executive approval for a retention package to keep Aurelia on Redwood. Summary of approved terms (subject to signed amendment and PO):
- One-time invoice credit of up to $115,000, applied to the first renewal invoice.
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime guarantee for 6 months on the production inference route; defined credit buckets for unplanned downtime.
- 10 days of engineering support (remote) to assist with migration and performance tuning.
- 12-month price lock and no increases during the term.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached the proposed amendment (proposed_amendment_v1.pdf) — legal will need a signed copy and PO within 10 business days to activate the credits/SLA.
2) If these terms look good, please confirm who from Procurement will sign and the PO cadence, and I’ll send a DocuSign link.

If helpful, Marissa and Rishi are copied in for any additional context. We want to be flexible within the approved guards so you can avoid an RFP.

Best regards,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (pdf), Aurelia_Usage_Summary_Q3.xlsx (xlsx)
